frozen_rules.rule_1_automatic_admission: **Rule 1 -- Automatic admission of new series (append-only discovery log).** Any series created after this manifest whose official Kalshi metadata satisfies the inclusion predicate above is added to Collection Universe v1 automatically, from the first census that discovers it. Its admission is logged append-only with the discovery timestamp and the verbatim metadata that satisfied the predicate. No backfill is attempted and none is possible: history before the discovering census is simply unavailable, and the record says so rather than interpolating it.
frozen_rules.rule_2_append_only_inclusion: **Rule 2 -- Inclusion is append-only for the collection period.** Once a series qualifies, it remains in Collection Universe v1 through the frozen collection end date even if Kalshi later edits, relabels, or removes the metadata that admitted it. Membership is a fact about what the metadata said when the series was admitted, not a live query. Nothing is ever removed from v1 during the collection period; a later metadata change is recorded as an observation, never as an eviction.

gates.gate_3_complete_evidence: passed -- every series in the catalog was read successfully

inclusion_predicate.operator: exact case-sensitive string equality, existential over the series' events
inclusion_predicate.prose:
A Kalshi series S is a member of Collection Universe v1 if and only if at least one event E returned by `GET /events?series_ticker=<S.series_ticker>` satisfies

        E["product_metadata"]["competition"] == "Pro Baseball"

under exact, case-sensitive string equality. `"Pro Baseball"` is Kalshi's own value for Major League Baseball in that controlled field; the literal string `"MLB"` never appears in it. Nothing else is consulted: no ticker prefix or substring, no title text, no tag, no category, no settlement source, no fuzzy or substring matching.

provenance.prefilter: none -- the predicate is evaluated over the entire catalog
